title: Dismals Canyon
subtitle: Moss, stone, and a night that glows
summary: Four of us dropped into a sandstone canyon in northwest Alabama—boardwalks over clear water, fern-covered cliffs, and after dark, the soft blue of dismalites. Peng, Carlie, Ragen, and Joel. One long day. A lot of frames.
tips: Trails can be slick after rain—good shoes help
Stay for the night tour if you can; the glowworms are the point
Pack a light layer; the canyon floor stays cooler than the parking lot

items.title: Arrive & drop in
items.description: Park, stretch, and take the path down into the sandstone cut. First frames of green light and water.

items.title: Canyon walk
items.description: Boardwalks, rock walls, and cool air. Stop whenever the light hits the moss right.

items.title: Golden hour in the cut
items.description: Late light through the trees. Portraits, details, and the four of us in the frame.

items.title: Blue hour & water
items.description: Quieter light, reflections, and the last open-shutter moments before dark.

items.title: Dismalites
items.description: Night in the canyon—look up for the blue glow. Slow walk out under the trees.

title: Tom Lee Park
subtitle: Independence Day on the river
summary: Fourth of July on the Mississippi at Tom Lee Park—late light on the river, fireworks weather, and a long golden evening by the water.
tips: Arrive early if you want a spot with a clear river view
Evenings can cool off once the sun drops—bring a light layer
Phone and camera batteries drain fast with night and fireworks shots

items.title: Arrive at Tom Lee Park
items.description: Find a stretch of grass with a view of the river and settle in.

items.title: Golden hour on the water
items.description: River light, silhouettes, and the crowd easing into the evening.

items.title: Blue hour
items.description: City lights come on; frames get quieter between the celebrations.

items.title: Night on the Mississippi
items.description: Independence Day night by the river—fireworks energy and long exposures.

title: Mother Earth Troll Garden
subtitle: Sculptures, garden paths, and a slow afternoon
summary: Peng, Carlie, and Shreya walked the garden paths among the troll sculptures—green light, quiet corners, and a lot of frames between the trees.
tips: Wear shoes that can handle dirt paths and damp grass
Midday light through the trees is soft—good for portraits and details
Give yourself time; the sculptures reward a slow walk

items.title: Arrive
items.description: Meet up, stretch, and step into the garden.

items.title: Troll trail
items.description: Follow the paths between sculptures—stop for portraits and close-ups.

items.title: Shade & details
items.description: Moss, wood, and the smaller figures tucked into the greenery.

items.title: Late light
items.description: Softer light on the big sculptures and a last loop of the grounds.
